title: ADI Forge Contributor Terms
body:
These terms apply when you author or review tasks on ADI Forge, operated by ADI-Labs.ai("we", "us").

1. Your role
You take part as an independent contributor, as a subject-matter expert (SME) who authors tasks or as a Reviewer who reviews them. These terms do not create employment, partnership or agency. Work is offered task by task; we do not guarantee any amount of work.

2. Assignments
A project manager or administrator assigns each task to you. Work only on tasks assigned to you, follow the task's instructions and template, and submit by the date shown. You may decline an assignment before you start it.

3. Synthetic data only
All task content must be synthetic. Never enter real customer, client, employer or personal data, including names, account numbers, identity documents or ID numbers, even if anonymised. Do not copy confidential material from any current or past employer or client. If you are unsure whether something is allowed, do not include it and ask your project manager.

4. Quality and honesty
Submit your own work, to the best of your professional knowledge. Do not misrepresent your qualifications or experience. You may use the in-task Help assistant for guidance, but you remain responsible for what you submit.

5. Review and decisions
Your work may be reviewed by a Reviewer and is approved, sent back for rework or rejected by a person (a project manager or administrator). Automated tools may assist reviewers but never make the final decision.

6. Conduct
Be respectful in comments and communications. Do not share your account, attempt to access tasks or data not assigned to you, or interfere with the platform.

7. Ending participation
You may stop taking part at any time by telling us. We may end your access if you breach these terms. Sections on confidentiality, intellectual property and data use continue after you stop.

8. Other terms
These terms work together with the ADI Forge Confidentiality and IP terms and the Data Use terms, which you must also accept. We may update these terms; you will be asked to accept the new version before your next assignment. Questions: [contact email].

By selecting "I accept", you confirm you have read and agree to these terms.
